item.description: NZ Ecologist wins Shorland Medal Distinguished Professor Philip Hulme from Lincoln University has been awarded the prestigious Shorland Medal by the New Zealand Association of Scientists for his sustained and valuable contributions to ecology - both in New Zealand and worldwide.
